title: Figure 13: MEMS thermopile glucose sensor - thermoelectric enzyme sensor schematic
description: Slide titled "Thermoelectric Enzyme Sensor Schematic" giving reactions "Glucose + O2 ---> H2O2 + Gluconic Acid + 79 kJ" and "H2O2 ---> H2O + 1/2 O2 + 100 kJ" above a cross-section showing "Oxygen" and "Glucose" entering an "Enzyme Gel / Glucose Oxidase & Catalase" layer on "Thin Mylar," with "Heat" flowing to "Sensing Junctions" flanked by "Reference Junctions" over "Insulation." The caption reads "Figure 13. A MEMS Thermopile Glucose Sensor (Towe et al., Arizona State University)."
